reply.text:
Elbow tendon soreness is one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so I won't assess it or suggest how to train around it. Get it looked at, and once they've cleared you for pulling work, I'll help you set it up.

If you want the swap in the meantime, I can make it. Tell me which day the chin-ups sit on so I can swap them for neutral-grip pulldowns in your program.
